step1.construction: normal-force contact-width pullback from A only: F_j(d)=F_A(d)*x_j(d)/x_A(d), common mean normal pressure at fixed depth; x=rounded wedge halfwidth; nominal radii; no Gamma fitting
step1.relation: x=sqrt(2Rd-d^2) if d<R(1-sin(theta)), otherwise d*tan(theta)+R*cos(theta)/(1+sin(theta)); theta=angle/2
step1.evaluate: B,E,F,G at tabulated true-cut points for which d is between23 and96% of measured thickness; inversion via A piecewise linear; exclude grooves from fracture error; 100% full-through endpoints are censored; retain nonmonotonic data
step1.metric: relative force prediction error at independently observed heldout depth, tolerance20%; tabular rounding0.5pp propagated separately, no invented repeatability CI
step1.main_sharpness_test: B versus K is same-specimen, same-angle nominalradius0/50.8um at20lbf; predicted reference curve beyond fullcut reported censored; K40±2pp is actual true-cut observation

step2_on_failure.changed_operation: independent tip contact pressure gives additive normalforce kR rather than width scaling: F(d,R)=F_B(d)+kR. Acquire one F-edge anchor at12lbf,d65%; assume effectiveR_F=25.4um ONLY scenario, estimate k, predict K-edge at50.8um,F20lbf and F-edge16/20lbf without refit
step2_on_failure.important_scope: new additional acquisition using B fullcurve+one F datum, not advertised as one-geometry training; F radius is heterogeneous and unmeasured at cut location. Closure investigation, not verified empirical radius law
step2_on_failure.falsifier: K relative depth error>20% or2pp reading does not encompassprediction; invalidtrue/groove endpoint breaks force-work claim

needle_auxiliary.construction: calibrate friction-corrected force F=cD on0.3mm needle; predict0.6mm; inferno Gamma since area2a peradvance and openingenergy unknown
needle_auxiliary.metric: central relative pressure/force error and extreme digitization range; original20%gate on central, robust digitizationgate separate; no clinicalorindependent prospectivevalidation

power_port_change.construction: derive P=Ft*vt+Fn*vn; Fn at steadydepth has zero power sincevn=0; return unknown Ft/dU/processwork explicitly, not Fn/h
power_port_change.meaning: candidate effectivecutworks, not observations; positive work can vary with unobserved tangentforce while observed normalforce unchanged

strongest_control: same-information fullcontactcohesive model can use exact same pressure/offsetlaws; TIE if algebra matches; full uniform fine FE was NOT executed in this data round
